title: [DynISF] Between 23:00 - 00:00 TDD stats only 6 days
symptom: DynISF stops working between 23:00 and 00:00 because only 6 days of TDD are shown in AAPS Statistics. This issue is reproducible in latest dev and master, and can be reproduced by manually altering time in Android.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but it is implied that the issue is related to a time change (DST) or a bug in the date calculation around midnight.
fix: The thread does not state a fix, but a commit link is provided by MilosKozak: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/47758b6b27c6e8562d598e5c63ba0ffde6593cb3, which likely contains the fix.
evidence_quote: I can confirm in master 3.2.01. No daylight savings since I’ve started using 3.2 on October 30th and daylight savings happened on the 29th.
